selection_criteria: Stable blue chips: (1) large cap, over $75B; (2) 25+ consecutive years of dividend increases (S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrat), which means steady earnings through 2000-02, 2008-09 and 2020; (3) beta under 1 on TradingView when picked (Nov 2026). Berkshire Hathaway is the one exception to (2): it pays no dividend but has a 60-year low-volatility record. Edit freely.
